Night in ONE vast collection hall with a continuous flat floor. SOUTH entrance; NORTH balcony; objects arranged on low display furniture along the perimeter walls, with no readable labels. Zahhak examines one small referenced object with his free hand, staff planted. Drift gently beside the display; do not rack focus onto Jamshid.

SHOT 09-02 | 6s–10s | 4 SECONDS

65mm close from NORTHWEST across the table. Zahhak's free hand rotates the same object slightly to inspect its surface, then sets it down carefully. His masked face remains angled down toward it; subtle serpent movement crosses the upper frame. He gives no acknowledgment of the captive.

SHOT 09-03 | 10s–15s | 5 SECONDS

35mm low medium-wide from the NORTH side, moved laterally east of the previous camera. Zahhak remains large foreground, Jamshid small background with guards; the machine stays readable but out of emphasis. Zahhak shifts his attention to the next object and inclines his head toward the display. Jamshid lifts his chin in expectation. Zahhak does not turn, glance, pause in response, or make eye contact.

END STATE AND EDIT

Zahhak continues browsing the NORTH display. Jamshid waits in the same position SOUTHWEST of the machine; no command has yet been given. Machine OFF. Preserve the sustained refusal to acknowledge him.

SOUND

Close object handling and a staff tip settling; distant captive breath and guard clothing, harbor ambience. No dramatic silence or score.

NO MUSIC. NO DIALOGUE.
